items.question: How many days does this retailer take to credit a refund to your card, bank account, PayPal or Tabby account after checking a returned item?
items.fact: Refunds to card, bank, PayPal or Tabby take 4-15 days.

items.question: Can an Iconic product be returned to any store of this retailer, or only to an Iconic store?
items.gold: Iconic products can only be returned to an Iconic store.
items.fact: Iconic products must be returned to an Iconic store.
